tagline: New York just had its first live 3D hololive weekend, BY THE BEAT's summer MV has been looping since Tuesday, and NIJISANJI EN's next male wave wants streamers who go all-in on the immersion.
inThisIssue: Anime NYC 2026 wrapped: SUPER KARAOKE PARTY through HOLOSTARS EN closing day
BY THE BEAT drops the MERORI MV — night pool party, Latin pop, bilingual rollout
hololive English x Sunright Tea boba collab opens August 28 across the West Coast

lead.title: Anime NYC 2026 closes out: hololive production's first New York 3D live, a 150,000-fan weekend, and HOLOSTARS EN taking the Javits Center on Sunday
lead.body: The hololive production footprint at Anime NYC 2026 spent three consecutive days proving the format works at convention scale in New York City. Friday was SUPER KARAOKE PARTY at the Javits Center: Mori Calliope, Kobo Kanaeru, Koseki Bijou, and Nerissa Ravencroft performing live in 3D in a city that had never seen the format. Anime NYC attendance ran near 150,000 for the weekend, and the SUPER KARAOKE PARTY required a separate ticket on top of a standard badge — every person in that room bought in specifically for the live. Saturday expanded into ten talents across panels and live streams: Fuwamoco, Ouro Kronii, Raora Panthera, Ninomae Ina'nis, Cecilia Immergreen, Isaki Riona, Koganei Niko, Shirakami Fubuki, Nakiri Ayame, and Ookami Mio. Sunday closed the weekend with HOLOSTARS EN — Axel Syrios, Octavio, Machina X Flayon, and Banzoin Hakka — marking the Stars' first appearance at an Anime NYC. Three days, fourteen talents across JP, EN, and HOLOSTARS EN branches, one convention floor. The clip cycle from Friday's live is still running today, and attendee posts from all three days are filling community boards. This is the largest single-convention deployment of hololive production talent in North America on record.

stories.title: Nijisanji five-night ABEMA collab wraps: ten livers into mainstream Japanese variety TV, one pair per night
stories.blurb: ABEMA ran a dedicated Nijisanji collab week for its seiyuu variety show Seiyuu to Yoasobi 2026 from August 17 to 21. Ten Nijisanji livers appeared in consecutive pairs: Saeki Ittetsu and Joe Rikichi on Monday, Kuramochi Meruto and Honma Himawari on Tuesday, Shikinagi Akira and Seraph Dazzlegarden on Wednesday, Fushimi Gaku and Yumeoi Kakeru on Thursday, Kaida Haru and Leos Vincent on Friday. The format dropped VTubers into a voice actor variety context and ran talk segments and game segments all week. After-air clips from the collab are running on social through the weekend. Saeki Ittetsu noted being nervous going in; Leos Vincent reportedly needed no warm-up time whatsoever. The week functioned as a sustained cross-media moment for the brand.

stories.title: BY THE BEAT's MERORI MV is out — night pool party concept, Latin pop production, Japanese version MV coming August 25
stories.blurb: NIJISANJI EN's BY THE BEAT — Zeal Ginjoka, Freodore, Seible, and Kaelix Debonair — released the official MV for their second digital single MERORI on August 19. The video puts fan mascots at a night pool party and builds around the mero mero wordplay, meaning head-over-heels in Japanese. Production leans Latin-pop with summer event energy that matches the delivery window. The Japanese version MERORI (For Me) gets its own MV on August 25, a one-week gap between two distinct video treatments of the same single. The structured bilingual rollout is more deliberate than their first release and the community has taken notice — both in the expected ways and a few unexpected ones.

stories.title: hololive English x Sunright Tea Studio boba collab launches August 28 — Bae, Nerissa, Cecilia, and Raora on the menu
stories.blurb: hololive English announced a limited-time collaboration with West Coast boba chain Sunright Tea Studio on August 21. Four drinks, four talents: Hakos Baelz gets a Tie Guan Yin with tiramisu foam, Nerissa Ravencroft a matcha frostie with cheese foam, Cecilia Immergreen a matcha milk tea with oreo, and Raora Panthera a brown sugar espresso boba oat latte. Every collab drink comes with a limited-edition plastic cup and a coaster while supplies last. The collab runs August 28 through September 11 at select locations across California, Nevada, and Washington. It is the first Sunright x hololive activation and the first physical West Coast retail push for the EN branch this summer.

stories.title: NIJISANJI EN opens Immersion-focused Male VTuber Audition — applications close August 29
stories.blurb: ANYCOLOR opened a new NIJISANJI EN audition track this week specifically framed around immersion and male talent, with applications closing August 29 at 11:59 PM PDT. The standard requirements apply: 18 or older, fluent English with multilinguals welcome, livestreaming experience, consistent content commitment. The immersion framing is the new element — the announcement emphasizes performing as a male character with depth, which is reading as a creative direction signal rather than just a talent spec. NIJISANJI EN has run open regular auditions since March 2026; this is a separate targeted wave with a hard deadline at the end of next week.

stories.title: Phase Saga at nine weeks out: four members active, no replacement announced, October anniversary still on the calendar
stories.blurb: Phase Connect's Phase Saga generation turns one in October with four of its six original members actively streaming: Malice Evermore, Nitya Nil, Wilhelmina Frost, and Bibi Biscuit. Kaminari Clara graduated in February and Anya Nyabyss on August 1, both citing management disagreements. Phase Con 2026 in June passed without a new generation reveal. Nine weeks to the anniversary and Phase Connect has not announced a replacement wave or a new gen. The agency's public posture is consistent streaming support for the remaining four with no roadmap statement. Whether October becomes a quiet milestone or a launch window is the main open question about the label heading into Q4.

indieSubhead: NO AGENCY, NO PROBLEM — NEWS FROM THE SELF-MADE CORNER OF THE SCENE

indies.title: Pokiyaki one week in: the cyborg VTuber's re-debut held its audience into regular streaming territory
indies.blurb: Pokiyaki, the cyborg-persona indie VTuber who re-debuted on August 17, is seven days into their return and posting regular streams. Re-debuting in the 2026 English-language indie space means competing with a field that grew significantly after VShojo's 2025 closure moved established agency talent into the independent lane. The cyborg concept gave the return clip cycle a specific hook. The question every re-debut faces by week two is whether the initial traffic spike converts to a regular viewer base. The current channel activity suggests the conversion held, and the content calendar is running.

indies.title: August ranking update: indie watch-time majority holds for the third consecutive quarter, subscriber peaks still agency territory
indies.blurb: vchavcha's August 2026 data confirms the split that has defined the year: Houshou Marine holds the most-subscribed active VTuber position globally, the subscriber ceiling stays agency talent, but aggregate watch time sits above 50% on the indie and creator-led side for a third quarter running. The structural cause remains consistent — VShojo's 2025 closure and PRISM's 2024 shutdown moved their highest-watch-time talent into the independent column and audiences followed. The trend has stabilized. It is no longer being called a transition. It is the baseline.

indies.title: Anime NYC's indie gap: the most-watched independent VTubers in the West held no convention panels this weekend
indies.blurb: Anime NYC 2026 ran three full days with hololive production holding most of the VTuber panel and live programming. The indie and creator-led VTubers who collectively account for more than half of English VTuber watch time had minimal convention presence at the invite or panel level. Dexerto's August ranking of the top twenty most popular VTubers shows several of the most-watched English-language names are fully independent. Convention programming has not updated to reflect where the viewership actually lives. The community noted the gap at every major North American convention in 2026. Anime NYC made it visible again with the clearest example yet.

tea.text: Word on /vt/ is that the HOLOSTARS EN Sunday set at Anime NYC was the sleeper hit of the whole weekend. The SUPER KARAOKE PARTY had the presale hype and the clip traffic, but multiple attendees posting in post-con threads described accidentally staying for Sunday after buying a badge primarily for Saturday and being surprised by the energy in the room. Several threads in the last 24 hours are framing the Stars' first Anime NYC appearance as a format that should run back at every convention going forward. Friday got the headlines. Sunday got the converts.

The rumor mill says the NIJISANJI EN Immersion-focused Male Audition wording has /vt/ convinced ANYCOLOR already has a specific creative concept mapped for this wave. The three leading theories are heavy-RP content, lore-integrated world-building, and a JP-crossover-adjacent pipeline. The counter-argument is that immersion is marketing language and the concept will only be visible at debut. Both sides agree the framing is unusual relative to prior NIJISANJI EN audition announcements. The debate resolves whenever the wave debuts, which is at minimum several months out from the August 29 close.

The BY THE BEAT MERORI MV dropped Tuesday and by Wednesday /vt/ had a dedicated thread analyzing whether the fan mascot role in the night pool party video is parasocial fantasy execution or standard idol MV grammar. The thread ran 400 posts before someone pointed out that most idol MVs use the same shot structure, at which point it collapsed into a general VTuber content expectations argument. The Japanese version MERORI (For Me) MV drops tomorrow night. The /vt/ consensus is that this will either restart the exact same argument in a new thread or generate an entirely different one about whether the English and Japanese versions are addressed to different audiences on purpose.

The Filian situation crossed twelve weeks since filianislost.com zeroed without a reveal this weekend. The current leading /vt/ theory is that Phase 2 is an interactive or participatory unlock — not a debut stream but a mechanism the audience needs to find and trigger. A secondary thread argues this reads as cope and the project quietly dissolved after June. The X account still reads DEBUT DELAYED. The domain is still registered. Neither camp has produced evidence of anything. Week twelve and the only consensus is that this has run longer than any normal VTuber countdown by a significant margin.

footerNote: Next signal drops Monday, 31 August — holonatsu Paradise opens in Shanghai on Sunday, the MERORI (For Me) MV lands Tuesday night, Phase Connect's October window is eight weeks closer than it was this morning, and the NIJISANJI EN auditions will have closed. See you in seven.
